question: The Rathwas, who dwell in the state of ___________, perform the Rathwa dance on the occasion of Holi (festival of colours).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rathwas, who dwell in the state of **Gujarat**, perform the Rathwa dance on the occasion of Holi (festival of colours).
 
• Rathwa dance is a traditional dance form performed by the Rathwa tribe in Gujarat.
 
• The dance is characterized by its vibrant costumes and energetic movements, reflecting the cultural heritage of the Rathwa community.
 
• Holi, known as the festival of colours, is celebrated with great enthusiasm in various parts of India, including Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rathwa tribe is predominantly found in the Chhota Udaipur district of Gujarat.
 
• Holi is celebrated on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna (February-March) and marks the arrival of spring.
 
• The festival signifies the victory of good over evil and is celebrated with the throwing of coloured powders and water.
 
• Besides the Rathwa dance, Gujarat is also known for other traditional dance forms such as Garba and Dandiya.
